profile.name: 数据采集流水线阶段
profile.description: 用于实验数据采集系统中的单个处理阶段的软件组件，负责在采集流水线中组织进程、队列和消息传递，并可配置具体处理类。它常用于高通量实验或探测器数据流的在线处理、分发、预处理以及按批次标识保存数据。
profile.description_en: A software component representing a single stage in an experimental data acquisition pipeline. It manages processes, queues, and message passing, and can be configured with a specific processing class. It is used for online handling, routing, preprocessing, and train-ID-based saving of streaming experimental or detector data.

registry.name: Defines a single acquisition stage
registry.description: Acquisition Stage是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、参数配置、启动、运行。支持Signal, Slot, addStage等操作。
